specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_empty_left
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_empty_left : ∀ (b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond #[] b), LongestCommonSubsequence #[] b h_precond = 0

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_empty_right
specs.stmt: ∀ (a : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a #[]), LongestCommonSubsequence a #[] h_precond = 0

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_nonneg
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_nonneg : ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b), LongestCommonSubsequence a b h_precond ≥ 0

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_le_right_size
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b),
    LongestCommonSubsequence a b h_precond ≤ b.size

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_symm
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_symm : ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h1 : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b) (h2 : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond b a), LongestCommonSubsequence a b h1 = LongestCommonSubsequence b a h2

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_meets_postcond
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_meets_postcond : ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b), LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond a b (LongestCommonSubsequence a b h_precond) h_precond

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_result_le_both_sizes
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_result_le_both_sizes : ∀ (a b : Array Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond a b), LongestCommonSubsequence a b h_precond ≤ (min a.size b.size : Int)

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_single_diff
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_single_diff : ∀ (x y : Int) (h_precond : LongestCommonSubsequence_precond #[x] #[y]), x ≠ y → LongestCommonSubsequence #[x] #[y] h_precond = 0

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_same_args
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_same_args : LongestCommonSubsequence a a trivial = LongestCommonSubsequence a a trivial

specs.name: LongestCommonSubsequence_third_eq_second_idempotent
specs.stmt: theorem LongestCommonSubsequence_third_eq_second_idempotent : LongestCommonSubsequence a b trivial = LongestCommonSubsequence a b trivial
